findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends, and all listed references must be cited in the manuscript.
findings.problem: References [3], [5], [6], [7], [9], [10], [11], and [12] appear in the reference list but are not cited anywhere in the manuscript.

findings.rule: When an article has been accepted for publication but not yet appeared in print, the reference must include a DOI URL.
findings.problem: Reference [11] (Nature (in press)) does not include a DOI.
